narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no pauses between sentences.

anna.instruct: Tense, precise, high-strung young woman, quietly horrified, quick and clipped.

mel.instruct: Warm, delighted party host, gushing and fast, then laughing it off.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your Virgo friend brought a label maker to your party.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Anna and she's smart and helpful and terrifyingly organized.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her spice rack is alphabetical and her closet is color-coded.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Even her to-do list has its own to-do list.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In ten minutes she has labelled your whole kitchen.

lines.speaker: mel
lines.text: Anna, this is actually amazing!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Anna glows because someone finally appreciates the system.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then she sees the picture frame on the wall.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's tilted two degrees to the left.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She can't hear the music or the guests anymore.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Does nobody else see this?

lines.speaker: mel
lines.text: See what? It's a party!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What's going on inside a Virgo?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture an office with a giant red stamp marked wrong.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It has never once been put down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A ruler on the wall is labelled two degrees.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A clipboard says fix it and the list never ends.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And in a drawer a tiny note says I'm tired.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody ever reads that one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Anna climbs the bookshelf to straighten the frame.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The bookshelf goes over and she lands on the couch.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The frame is now perfectly straight and Anna is happy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then she spots Mel's boyfriend and reaches for the label maker.
